correctness.rationale: The matrix is precisely the published 16-by-16 cohomology matrix; three exact symbolic determinant witnesses exclude vertical factors. A 3-plane section of a fixed quadratic fiber specializes to a ternary quartic over F_101 with exactly three noncollinear ordinary nodes, proving geometric integrality and hence an integral generic fiber in a flat projective family. No vertical components occur; the unique horizontal component has multiplicity one. The exact standalone verifier replayed CERTIFICATE_OK; the open unramified restriction is nonempty by the published smooth-point construction.

value.rationale: This natural geometrically defined first normal-bundle jumping divisor is known to exist with a computed class but could a priori have multiple components or multiplicities. Proving it integral identifies one unique degeneration family and establishes that the divisor class represents a reduced irreducible wall, relevant to intersection theory and compactification boundaries rather than an arbitrary small calculation.
